en.quote: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good. For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment. Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
en.riddle: I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
en.speaker: Job

bonus_hint.quote: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

he.quote: מִשְׁפָּט נִבְחֲרָה־לָּנוּ נֵדְעָה בֵינֵינוּ מַה־טּֽוֹב כִּֽי־אָמַר אִיּוֹב צָדַקְתִּי וְאֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי עַל־מִשְׁפָּטִי אֲכַזֵּב אָנוּשׁ חִצִּי בְלִי־פָֽשַׁע
he.speaker: אִיּוֹב

bonus_hint.quote: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הָאוֹר כִּי־טוֹב וַיַּבְדֵּל אֱלֹהִים בֵּין הָאוֹר וּבֵין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ

en.4: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
en.5: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
en.6: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.

he.5: כִּֽי־אָמַר אִיּוֹב צָדַקְתִּי וְאֵל הֵסִיר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי׃
